posts.text: I am pleased to nominate Jim O’Neill to serve as Judge on the United States District Court for the Middle District of North Carolina. posts.text: I am proud to announce that the FIFA Women's World Cup 2031 will take place in the United States! After hosting the Most Successful World Cup in History, no Country is better positioned than the United States to be home to the largest Women's Sporting Event in History.
